name: Juniper Green Energy Limited
summary: Juniper Green Energy Private Limited operates as an independent renewable energy power producer and operator. The company's portfolio of projects includes wind, solar, wind-solar hybrid (WSH), firm and dispatchable renewable energy (FDRE), and battery energy storage systems. The company develops, constructs, and operates renewable energy projects, providing end-to-end engineering, procurement, and construction services, as well as operations and maintenance services. It manages cross-border electricity supply projects, including the commissioning of solar power projects for international clients. The company also undertakes social responsibility initiatives.
